Spray Dried Apple Powder for Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried apple powder for bakeries, beverage brands, confectioners and supplement makers. Fresh apple juice is spray dried into a fine, light powder with a clean fruity aroma. It dissolves well and gives a steady flavor from one batch to the next. That makes it easy for food manufacturers to add to new or existing product lines without reworking a recipe.

Processing Method

Production starts with ripe apples that are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The fruit is washed and pressed, and the juice is filtered to remove pulp and fiber. The clear juice is then sprayed as a fine mist into hot air inside the dryer. Water evaporates in seconds and the solids fall out as a uniform powder. Because each droplet dries so fast, the spray dried apple powder keeps a light natural color and a fresh apple taste. Each batch is checked for moisture and mesh before it is packed.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Apple Powder?

Buyers who work with a dedicated spray dried apple powder supplier usually want one thing above all: consistency. Fruit ingredients can vary a lot between suppliers and seasons. We work to a fixed specification, so the powder you receive matches the one you approved. It is easy to weigh and blend, and it stays stable in sealed packs, which suits long export routes. If you need a bulk spray dried apple powder supplier India can offer, Tradenest Naturals ships worldwide with full export documentation support.

Versatile Industrial Applications

The powder works across many categories. Beverage makers use it in instant fruit drinks and drink mixes. Bakers add it to breads, muffins and fillings for a mild apple note. Confectioners use it in flavored candies and coatings. Supplement brands use it as a fruit base for powders and chewables. It is a simple, single-ingredient option for teams building shorter ingredient lists. Composition details are on the specification sheet.

Quality Assurance and Standards

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our team checks moisture, mesh size and appearance on every batch before dispatch. Each lot carries a batch number for traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This gives your quality team the information it needs before approval.

Frequently Asked Questions for Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried apple powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger orders receive better pricing, but small lots for pilot trials are welcome. Contact us for a quote based on your needs. What certifications and quality standards apply? We hold an FSSAI food business registration and IEC export registration, and we support buyers with export documents. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? Options include 25 kg bulk bags, stand-up pouches and OEM or private label packing. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)? The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Composition, including any carrier used in drying, is stated on the specification sheet. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on order volume and packing requirements. Samples are available on request. To ask for a sample or a formal quote, contact our sales team through the website.
